about: The lending AMM release gate's test builds: copies of the program with a mistake that would strand a live market, each one careless edit to a copy of its source, built by scripts/broken-builds.py with the fuzzer's broken builds and run by gate/tests/markets.rs, which checks that the gate refuses each one. The program's own source never carries them.

builds.name: moves-a-field
builds.why: The recorded cTokens moved after the running total deposited, as a careless reordering of the market state's fields would: every live market's cTokens and totals are read from the wrong bytes.
builds.gate: refused on every market holding cTokens

builds.name: rebalance-lends-nothing
builds.why: rebalance succeeds but never deposits, as a careless edit to its plan would leave it: no market lends again, and a gate that only checks a rebalance's transaction would never reach a sale that redeems from Kamino (review finding of #87's part 1).
builds.gate: refused on its own market, and on every market where the deployed build lent and then sold beyond the buffer
